items.t: 정부, MS365 장애 비상대응반 구성…MS “근본 문제 해결”
items.d: 정부가 마이크로소프트(MS)의 글로벌 서비스 장애에 대응해 한국MS와 비상대응반을 구성하고 국내 이용자 불편과 피해 상황 점검에 나섰다. MS는 고객과 파트너에게 공식 사과하고, 서비스 전반에서 광범위한 복구와 안정화가 이뤄지고 있다고 설명했다. 과학기술정보통신부(이하 과기정통부)는 한국MS와 비상대응반을 구성해 MS365 서비스 복구 현황과 국내 이용자 불편 상황을 지속 점검하는 등 대응에 나서고 있다고 14일 밝혔다. 지난 13일(한국시간)
items.fullText: AI·SW SW 정부, MS365 장애 비상대응반 구성…MS “근본 문제 해결” 발행일 : 2026-11-14 16:03 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 마이크로소프트 정부가 마이크로소프트(MS)의 글로벌 서비스 장애에 대응해 한국MS와 비상대응반을 구성하고 국내 이용자 불편과 피해 상황 점검에 나섰다. MS는 고객과 파트너에게 공식 사과하고, 서비스 전반에서 광범위한 복구와 안정화가 이뤄지고 있다고 설명했다. 과학기술정보통신부(이하 과기정통부)는 한국MS와 비상대응반을 구성해 MS365 서비스 복구 현황과 국내 이용자 불편 상황을 지속 점검하는 등 대응에 나서고 있다고 14일 밝혔다. 지난 13일(한국시간) MS365 서비스와 이메일 서비스 아웃룩, 화상회의·메신저 서비스 팀스 등에 장애가 발생하여 국내 일부 기업에서도 이메일 송수신에 차질이 발생했다. 오픈AI와 앤트로픽 등 다른 AI 서비스의 MS365 연동 기능도 영향을 받았다. 과기정통부는 한국MS를 통해 서비스 복구 현황과 국내 이용자 불편·피해 신고 상황을 확인했다. 국내 주요 플랫폼 사업자들에게도 장애 예방을 위한 자체 시스템 점검을 실시하도록 조치했다. MS도 공식 X에 사과문을 게시하고 “이번 사안으로 고객과 파트너 여러분께 불편을 초래한 점에 대해 깊이 사과드린다”며 “고객과 파트너가 서비스에 보내는 신뢰에 따른 책임을 엄중하게 받아들이고 있다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “장애의 근본적인 문제를 해결했으며, 서비스 전반에서 광범위한 복구와 안정화가 이뤄지고 있다”며 ”다만 일부 고객과 지역에 대해서는 복구 작업을 계속 진행하고 있다“고 덧붙였다. 특히 MS는 사이버 공격이나 인공지능(AI)·에이전트와의 관련성은 부인했다. 이번 장애는 이전 네트워크 용량 업그레이드 과정에서 발생한 문제가 잠재되어 있다가 최근 네트워크 변경 이후 표면화되면서 발생했다고 설명했다. 복구에 시간이 걸린 배경도 설명했다. 대규모 수요를 고려해 각 단계에서 안정성을 확인하며 서비스를 점진적으로 복구했고, 이 때문에 시간이 더 소요됐지만 안정적인 복구를 보장하기 위한 조치였다는 것이다. 강성전 기자 castlekang@etnews.com

items.t: Uber confirms hackers stole thousands of drivers’ license information in data breach
items.d: The ridesharing giant said drivers' license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.
items.fullText: Uber is notifying thousands of drivers that their personal and driver’s license information was stolen during an October data breach at one of the company’s tech providers. In notices filed this week with several U.S. attorneys general, including California , the ride-hail giant said it was notified on October 9 by the provider that hackers broke in and stole internal credentials, which were used to access Uber’s data. The company said it subsequently began notifying affected drivers that their personal information was stored with the provider. TechCrunch has learned that the provider is Fireworks AI, which lets developers access and use open AI models. Fireworks reported a data breach last month in which hackers stole its customers’ information, including billing data and some private AI datasets. Online productivity startup Notion confirmed its data was also stolen in the Fireworks hack. “The notices to drivers are in relation to a security incident impacting one of our third-party vendors, Fireworks.ai, which had access to some Uber data,” an Uber spokesperson told TechCrunch, deferring our questions to Fireworks. Uber did not say how many customers are affected by the breach, nor how many drivers it was notifying about the incident. When reached by email, a spokesperson for Fireworks confirmed that the company identified a security issue involving unauthorized access to some of its systems, which affected customer data, but the spokesperson did not address our questions about the incident. According to data breach notices seen by TechCrunch, the stolen data includes driver’s licenses of 2,567 individuals in Massachusetts, 3,430 people across South Carolina, and 1,873 residents of Rhode Island. A filing with Illinois showed that some state residents had their driver’s license information stolen, but that the number of affected people was pending. items.t: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full-blown global cloud crisis
items.d: Microsoft's daylong outage began with Outlook and Teams and ended up taking much of the company's cloud services offline. Microsoft says it's gradually restoring service.
items.fullText: Microsoft is slowly recovering from its daylong outage after much of the company’s systems were hit by a cascading software issue. The problems, which started Thursday, were initially flagged as affecting the company’s services in the U.S. and the Americas, but quickly spread around the world, as engineers struggled to recover downed servers. What began as an Outlook email and Teams video conferencing outage soon developed into a full-blown meltdown affecting the company’s cloud services for both consumer and business email, files, and documents. The outage also knocked out the company’s Copilot AI tools and Defender security screening software, and prevented system administrators from accessing their internal Intune dashboards and features. Some users reportedly experienced issues with accessing their cloud-based Windows computers. Microsoft hasn’t yet said what caused the issues, only saying the outage involved “a large number of servers being unexpectedly unavailable.” The company said it continues to investigate the cause. The outage affected a broad range of industries, including TechCrunch’s own email. We’ve reached out to Microsoft for comment about the incident. Image Credits: Fabrice COFFRINI / AFP / Getty Images As of Friday morning on the U.S. East Coast, Microsoft’s Outlook email service had begun to recover and some emails have been trickling in. The recovery comes after engineers initially could not find the cause of the issue that was causing servers in Microsoft’s data centers to fail. Doug Madory, the director of internet analysis at Kentik, a company that monitors internet traffic worldwide, said in a post on Bluesky that traffic was returning to Microsoft’s services after about 18 hours of downtime. Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.d: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
items.fullText: In its third-quarter earnings call Thursday, the neocloud company Nebius laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027, far more than Wall Street had expected. It’s an ambitious plan, but it rests on a string of planned projects that are already starting to show cracks. Nebius plans to fund the buildout by relying on customer pre-payments and loans backed by customer contracts — essentially using the future value of its data centers to finance their construction. But that can be a risky strategy if those projects get bogged down by delays or cancellations. “Building at this scale is hard, and delays are part of our industry right now,” CEO Arkady Volozh said during Thursday’s earnings call. “We are not immune.” The earnings announcement comes on the heels of reports that Microsoft is cooling on neocloud deals that aren’t delivering on time. That’s a problem for companies like Nebius, whose financing strategy is becoming more dependent on repayments. Because if it can’t get to capacity on time, it will keep piling on costs while revenues slip. One of Nebius’ largest customers is Microsoft, which is paying for AI computing capacity at a Vineland, New Jersey, data center that is now months behind schedule. Nebius’ contract with Microsoft is worth up to $19.4 billion, but it’s already letting deadlines slip. Only just over half of the Microsoft capacity is now planned for delivery by the end of the year, with the rest coming in Q2 2027. The delay is because DataOne, the third-party operator of the site, “decided to wind down the temporary generation faster than it was expected,” according to Andrey Korolenko, chief product and infrastructure officer, as the site switches over to Bloom Energy fuel cells. Still, that transition wasn’t entirely by choice. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to GeForce NOW , allowing players to experience the battle for Kronus through cloud gaming. There’s more on the horizon, with NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology coming to War Thunder and Where Winds Meet . Launching on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, the real-time strategy game returns to the series’ roots with large-scale battles, base building and a renewed fight for planet Kronus. Command the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons or the Adeptus Mechanicus, which makes their series debut. Build a base, secure resources and customize squads to the conflict across more than 70 campaign missions, playable solo or in co-op mode. The Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes offer more ways to put tactics to the test. GeForce NOW will bring the action to supported PCs, Macs, handhelds and other devices, with game downloads and updates handled in the cloud. Save the storage space for everyday essentials and planning for the next offensive. Wishlist the game on Steam , and stay tuned to GFN Thursday to prepare for launch. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Contribution and New AI Infrastructure At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community. November 10, 2026 by Warren Barkley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing. To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities. NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide. NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox. Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot . These tools help teams deploy, manage and scale GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes for AI factories. Together, these advancements mark a step forward in making Kubernetes the leading foundation for AI workloads at scale — empowering developers to build safer, more efficient AI infrastructure for the future.
